note: Synthetic turn endings patterned on real Claude Code sessions (offers, choices, blocked-on-you, progress, reports that close with a question). Written with crew's generic names — never real transcript text. Labels are model-authored and marked for human review; 'holdout' cases are never used to tune the prompt. report-long-todo was moved from holdout to dev after it informed a prompt rule. Every turn end is a reply to the developer and is spoken in one short line, progress and "started, will report back" included; only greetings and "no response requested" stay silent.
